## Authorization and source status
The owner directed **begin implementation quickly** after PLAN-01..06 merged in PR #61. This issue is the first **bounded IMP-001 implementation task**; it is **not** authorization for schema migrations, remote database mutation, paid model calls, real manuscript testing or deployment. Existing old draft PR #59 remains paused.

**Baseline observed on user's Windows 11 + Cursor Desktop (H:\cursor\cursor\Vellistry)** at merged-main `b51e385`:
- Node 24.13.0, `corepack pnpm@10.18.0`, 110GB free on H:;
- `corepack pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` **PASS**, ~176 packages, generates absent `pnpm-lock.yaml`;
- `corepack pnpm check` **PASS** (Nest and Next);
- `corepack pnpm build` **PASS** (Next 16.4 / Nest);
- currently on local `chore/pnpm-lockfile-baseline`; `apps/web/next-env.d.ts` was modified by Next build and `pnpm-lock.yaml` untracked.
- Existing CI intentionally used non-frozen installation because no lockfile previously tracked. Include and review a pinned lockfile in this scoped first PR; do not upgrade pnpm or repo dependencies without cause.

## Approved constraints
- Original repo root: `AGENTS.md`, `PROJECT-CONSTITUTION.md`, `SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md`, top `CURRENT-STATE.md`; PLAN-01 149 crosswalk, PLAN-02 data/auth, PLAN-03 UX states, PLAN-04 test plan, PLAN-05 Cursor workflow, PLAN-06 dependencies.
- Existing Next.js 16 / React 19 / NestJS 11 / Supabase Auth and RLS; existing `/login`, `/books`, Next BFF `/api/books` and Nest books module already present.
- Figma master design guides UX, but no pixel-perfect gate.
- **Supabase Cloud** `vellistry-dev` (project ref `lflkcrnriitrbclangyr`, HTTPS `https://lflkcrnriitrbclangyr.supabase.co`) created in owner's Free account. At last check **zero public tables and zero applied migrations**. Auth/DB integration behavior cannot be claimed PASS until reviewed schema setup and synthetic fixture testing. **No local Docker/WSL required**.
- Do not paste live API keys; only publishable key in appropriate untracked local env; never service_role in frontend. Do not call `supabase db reset`, `db push` or apply migrations to hosted project under this issue.

## In-scope (IMP-001 only)
1. Inspect existing actual Book Library and auth/Next BFF contracts before modifying. Keep user-owned `books` operations through Supabase Auth session and Nest current per-token authorization.
2. Correct account-switch / sign-out stale-data risk: late response from author A must never repopulate book titles for author B; 401/error clears or partitions sensitive list; refresh and retry are safe. Distinguish empty from loading, error, populated. Stable accessible labels/status and keyboard actions.
3. Ensure book create is protected against pending auth change/stale submission and no client-supplied owner_id; avoid revealing unauthenticated private metadata.
4. Add scoped *synthetic*, runnable regression tests for Aâ†’B account switching, delayed fetch, 401/error states, empty vs populated, and book create failure. Verify exact tests that can run without connecting real hosted DB. Record any tests blocked by missing Vellistry schema honestly.
5. Include missing `pnpm-lock.yaml` (generated with project-pinned Corepack pnpm 10.18.0). Inspect generated `apps/web/next-env.d.ts` diff: retain only if truly necessary; do not commit incidental generated noise. Avoid unrelated dependency upgrades.
6. Run actual `corepack pnpm check`, `corepack pnpm build` and focused test commands; provide output/exits and exact Git head SHA.

## Required acceptance / negatives
- `VEL-JRN-001`, `VEL-JRN-011`; `ACC-M1-01` (book create/reopen when schema exists), `ACC-M8-01` (cross-owner privacy), `ACC-M8-05` (accurate errors).
- `VEL-FEAT-01-002`, `VEL-FEAT-01-004`, `VEL-FEAT-17-001`, `VEL-FEAT-17-003`, `VEL-FEAT-17-005` and associated `T-VEL-...` row identities.
- A's pending fetch resolves after B signs in â†’ A's titles NEVER render under B.
- 401 or network failure â†’ no old book rows remain visible; clear actionable status.
- Zero book results show empty call to action; nonzero book results never show "No books yet".
- No secret/manuscript/author token in Git, URL, browser logs or test report.
- **Actual cloud RLS and direct PostgREST revoked-session risk remains unverified/release-gated**, not automatically solved by UI fixes.

## Workflow / output
- One feature branch (owner's current clean baseline branch may be renamed before first push) + a single **draft PR to `main`**. Do not work on `main` or revive PR #59.
- Tests `PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED|NOT_RUN` with commands and true fixtures; `FACT|INTERPRETATION|PROPOSAL` ExecutionBundle; no self-merge or deployment.
- If a host DB migration or remote data write is needed to verify the Book Library, STOP **that operation**, document exact reviewed schema/permission request, continue remaining non-mutating implementation/tests.

**Do not extend task into chapter CRUD, Tiptap editor, AI, profile/canon, rules, server architecture rewrite or hosted environment migration.**
